description: Margins, returns (ROE/ROA), leverage and liquidity ratios for a ticker, derived from SEC EDGAR fundamentals, plus per-share figures (eps_diluted, book_value_per_share, shares_outstanding). Price-based ratios (P/E, P/B) aren't returned because EDGAR has no market price; divide your own price by the per-share figures.
name: get_ratios
title: Get computed financial ratios
